summary: Iteration 27: Comprehensive testing of 4 NEW features - Financial Import/Export, Calendar iCal Import/Export, Event Recurrence Customizations, and Guest Pass QR Enhancements. All backend APIs pass (20/20 tests). All frontend UI elements verified working.
seed_data_creation: Test events, donations, and expenses created during testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 NEW features from iteration 27 are working: 1) Financial Import/Export (GET /api/financial/export with date_from, date_to, location_id params; POST /api/financial/import with donations/expenses arrays). 2) Calendar iCal Import/Export (GET /api/events/export/ical returns .ics file; POST /api/events/import/ical parses iCal text). 3) Event Recurrence (POST /api/events/generate-recurring supports daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly, nth_week patterns with end_date support). 4) Guest Pass QR (GET /api/access/guest-passes lists passes with time bounds; GET /api/access/guest-passes/{id}/validate returns valid, pass, message, location_name; PUT /api/access/guest-passes/{id}/extend with valid_days extends pass).

financial_export.details: Returns donations, expenses, donations_count, expenses_count. Supports date_from, date_to, location_id params.

financial_import.details: Accepts {donations:[], expenses:[]} and returns {donations_imported, expenses_imported}. Rejects empty data with 400.

ical_export.details: Returns text/calendar content with BEGIN:VCALENDAR format. Fixed NoneType bug in date/time handling.

ical_import.details: Parses iCal text and creates events. Returns {imported: count, message}.

recurring_nth_week.details: pattern=nth_week with day_of_week and nth_week params creates events on nth weekday of month

recurring_end_date.details: end_date parameter stops event creation early

guest_passes_list.details: Returns passes with valid_from_time, valid_until_time fields

guest_pass_extend.details: Accepts {valid_days: N} and extends pass validity

frontend_financial_modal.details: Import/Export button opens modal with Export JSON button and Import textarea

frontend_calendar_ical.details: Import iCal button opens modal with file upload and textarea inputs

frontend_calendar_recurring.details: Recurring Events button opens dialog with Daily, Yearly options and End Date field

frontend_access_guest_passes.details: Guest Passes tab shows passes with View QR, Validate, Extend buttons. QR code displays correctly.

frontend_events_recurrence.details: Create Event modal has Recurring toggle with Recurrence Type dropdown (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, nth_weekday, yearly) and End Date field

bug_fixed.issue: iCal export endpoint returned 500 error due to NoneType.replace() when event date/time fields were None
bug_fixed.fix: Changed ev.get('date', '') to (ev.get('date') or '') pattern to handle None values properly
